notes.title: New Tracks: Dramatic Transformation🌪
notes.content:
[b]Your Newest Challenger - Mother Nature[/b]
You face off against an opponent like no other - the unpredictable and capricious force of nature itself

[h2][b]Overcast[/b][/h2]
Welcome to the Overcast track, where the weather has undergone a dramatic transformation, rendering the once-familiar landscape unrecognizable. Dark, brooding clouds gather overhead, illuminated only by the brilliant flashes of lightning that pierce the layers of the atmosphere. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42279660/48d7b4f95bfea0c1cc6dc469247271e2d89e7181.png[/img]

[h2][b]Cerberus[/b][/h2]
On the Cerberus track, the atmosphere transforms once again. The race continues under the blinding rays of spotlights that pierce the darkness. Scarlet flashes of fire streak across the track, making every twist and turn a mesmerizing spectacle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42279660/d72585d79b36fe2d6adfadc16b79e819ede11017.png[/img]

[h2][b]Wharf[/b][/h2]
On the Warf track, the heavens themselves seem to conspire against you. Thick, swirling fog envelopes the surroundings, casting an eerie and mystical atmosphere over the race.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42279660/5c6bfcd997bb2e6d98d579fffb4abcbe5a37ea2d.png[/img]

As you navigate these ever-changing conditions, familiar turns become new challenges. 

So, gear up and get ready to embrace a new dimension of competition. 
Meet your new opponent - the weather, and let's take flight into the unknown, where every race is an unforgettable adventure.

[i]Yours ever,
Xocus[/i]

notes.title: REALTIME MULTIPLAYER 🚀
notes.content:
[b]Dear friends![/b]
It's an amazing day when we are happy to announce that realtime multiplayer is now available in Omega Pilot 🎊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42279660/536b2799c30b74d4fa887904175156aef69c4ea2.png[/img]

[b]Description of the update:[/b]
- Cross-platform multiplayer
- Global lobby from 2 to 10 people
- Voice chat
- All tracks are available 
- Level progression 

Let's take a closer look at the last point
Now you can level up and prove your superiority!

[b]Scoring system in multiplayer:[/b]
- 30 points for each race
- 200 points for everyday income
- 70 points for first place, 60 for second, 50 for third, 40 for fourth and 40, 35, 35, 30, 30, 25 etc. 

So hurry up to pump your level because soon it will be visible to everyone in the global leaderboard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42279660/49fd55c138bef53998755de1c1b6b86e0d9888e0.png[/img]

If your friends can't get together, don't be upset because you can always play with people from all over the world! Especially convenient to search for comrades on our discord -> https://discord.gg/JZVnvxaM

Join us and compete for the top spot!

[i]But remember that we are one big family and the important thing is not to win but to take part[/i]

[i]Yours ever,
Xocus[/i]

notes.title: VRoom VRoom 🏎 Major Update
notes.content:
[b]Dear Pilots! [/b]
Thank you for helping improve our game and for being with us along the way ❤️
We always listen to you and hear your requests!

Check out everything we have prepared for you down below 👇

[h1]ENDURANCE[/h1]
[h2]New racing mode[/h2]

Endurance racing is a form of motorsport racing which is meant to test the durability of equipment and endurance of participants. You attempt to cover a large distance in a single event with a pits during the race. In our game you will see indicators of fuel and health points. Don't neglect the pits if you see one or both of them decreasing. Strategy plays a big role as your victory depends on the accuracy of flying and reasonable fuel consumption. At the pit stop you will have a full tank and repair all the damage, so choose wisely how often to stop there. You can also select boosts just like in a regular race, but then more fuel will be consumed.

notes.title: We're back! Update time 🙏🏻
notes.content:
Now you can fly even faster and set the best time!
We've improved:
• ship collider (for more accurate cornering)
• brake system (force vectors are applied more correctly)
• control calibration system (now you calibrate in the menu and the zero position stays the same if you release the grab during the race)
New ship acceleration and deceleration animations have also been added for a more immersive experience 🏎

Enjoy Omega Pilot and look forward to upcoming tournament and a big update that will include new tracks, new racing ships and more!

notes.title: Major update before the full release
notes.content:
We are happy to present you our major update before the full release!
It will contain:
- Left-handed controls
- Sensitivity change
- Progressive steering feature
- New stopwatch (the comparison was with the previous lap in the same race before, and now it is compared with the best race in general)
- Autopilot
- Three new tracks
P.S regarding multiplayer
We announce that we have frozen the development of multiplayer
At the moment we don’t have enough people playing at the same time, we are happy to resume the development of multiplayer and release it if there are more players
Instead of multiplayer, we focused on control so that you can customize the control as it suits you and with the help of the autopilot you can go through the tracks that are difficult for you
We think of our players and finalize the details for the release!

notes.title: Pause update
notes.content:
Are you ready to exclaim "hooray" because now in Omega Pilot you can easily pause and restart the game 
Yes, you heard right! The pause and restart button is already inside and it has become much more convenient to play
Also, we could not leave you without a new wonderful track called "Refinery"
So check it out already now!
